**Current**
- Experts see him as a top 40 per game player with top 30 upside, and an outside shot at the top 25. Reaching about 60 to 65 games would make him a top 40 player overall. (verdict, 2026-10-13; [10-13](https://youtu.be/DzQXaC2rsac?t=883), [09-25](https://youtu.be/Bi1cEM03k9Y?t=962), [09-25](https://youtu.be/Bi1cEM03k9Y?t=982), [09-25](https://youtu.be/Bi1cEM03k9Y?t=1611), [09-17](https://youtu.be/ahNxsoU8Hx4?t=618), [09-14](https://youtu.be/LM0cRCGoAUQ?t=1578), [08-30](https://youtu.be/Alwse2uXzD4?t=1676), [08-19](https://youtu.be/J1Eg3uaAICU?t=1762), [08-11](https://youtu.be/OdDkXFhoKsc?t=1153), [09-07](https://youtu.be/E-KmhvyZ2CU?t=1162), [10-08](https://youtu.be/6DnRWahYrFA?t=1561))
- In expert mock drafts in October he went between picks 53 and 66, and in round five in some drafts. (fact, 2026-10-13; [10-13](https://youtu.be/DzQXaC2rsac?t=883), [10-12](https://youtu.be/w66x_I_MaQ8?t=777), [10-12](https://youtu.be/ENizLoE6pzI?t=754), [10-11](https://youtu.be/uI6umXsE7Vk?t=834), [10-08](https://youtu.be/WXO8MfQfzo0?t=979))
- Experts call his ADP of about 75 to 80 too low and would happily take him in the 60s. Round five is too early, and most drafts will not require it. (verdict, 2026-10-13; [10-13](https://youtu.be/DzQXaC2rsac?t=883), [10-08](https://youtu.be/WXO8MfQfzo0?t=979), [10-04](https://youtu.be/n4KkK-OJjqA?t=384), [10-04](https://youtu.be/n4KkK-OJjqA?t=976), [09-25](https://youtu.be/Bi1cEM03k9Y?t=962), [09-25](https://youtu.be/Bi1cEM03k9Y?t=982), [09-10](https://youtu.be/dlo7L8Ru91A?t=1173), [09-07](https://youtu.be/E-KmhvyZ2CU?t=1162))
- He is expected to miss some games, including about 8 to 10 of Boston's 16 back-to-backs. Most experts call the availability fears overdone and see a good chance he plays far more games than last season. Karalis is more negative and says he could miss about half the season. (verdict, 2026-10-08; [09-25](https://youtu.be/Bi1cEM03k9Y?t=1855), [10-08](https://youtu.be/6DnRWahYrFA?t=1561), [09-17](https://youtu.be/ahNxsoU8Hx4?t=610), [08-09](https://youtu.be/8d--aL_xxwE?t=1781), [07-30](https://youtu.be/TiiaNZCJNs8?t=2180))
- Experts expect his usage and minutes to rise, from 23 usage last season to about 26, in about 32 minutes. Josh rejects the idea that he will be a low-usage role player in Boston. (verdict, 2026-10-05; [09-17](https://youtu.be/ahNxsoU8Hx4?t=618), [09-10](https://youtu.be/dlo7L8Ru91A?t=1173), [07-13](https://youtu.be/Rqb5GdrSweY?t=1420), [10-04](https://youtu.be/n4KkK-OJjqA?t=1860), [07-02](https://youtu.be/P6TNP-g0wzY?t=488), [10-05](https://youtu.be/BiIZsSypx7Y?t=2166))
- He went for 15 USD in an expert auction mock. (fact, 2026-10-05; [10-05](https://youtu.be/Q6YlQDvD-aY?t=3693))
- Josh would pay up to 20 USD for him in an auction and calls 15 USD a very good price. (verdict, 2026-10-05; [10-05](https://youtu.be/Q6YlQDvD-aY?t=3693))
- He is the clear number two option in Boston behind Jayson Tatum and is a projected starter at forward. In Philadelphia he was the third option. (fact, 2026-10-04; [10-04](https://youtu.be/n4KkK-OJjqA?t=384), [09-25](https://youtu.be/Bi1cEM03k9Y?t=962), [09-14](https://youtu.be/LM0cRCGoAUQ?t=1578), [09-10](https://youtu.be/dlo7L8Ru91A?t=1173), [07-13](https://youtu.be/Rqb5GdrSweY?t=1420), [08-30](https://youtu.be/Alwse2uXzD4?t=1676), [08-19](https://youtu.be/J1Eg3uaAICU?t=1762), [08-30](https://youtu.be/Alwse2uXzD4?t=1671), [08-19](https://youtu.be/J1Eg3uaAICU?t=1755), [09-25](https://youtu.be/Bi1cEM03k9Y?t=848), [07-30](https://youtu.be/TiiaNZCJNs8?t=472))
- He is healthy, had no surgery this offseason and comes in fully rested. Most of his missed games last season came from a 25-game PED suspension and a return from knee surgery. (fact, 2026-10-04; [09-25](https://youtu.be/Bi1cEM03k9Y?t=894), [09-17](https://youtu.be/ahNxsoU8Hx4?t=618), [10-04](https://youtu.be/n4KkK-OJjqA?t=1860), [08-19](https://youtu.be/J1Eg3uaAICU?t=1762), [08-09](https://youtu.be/8d--aL_xxwE?t=1781))
- Boston has 16 back-to-backs, tied for the most in the league, with three of them in our playoff window. Its playoff schedule is 4-3-4 games through March 28, one game short of the maximum. (fact, 2026-09-26; [09-26](https://youtu.be/3UGI05PDvrE?t=1585), [09-25](https://youtu.be/Bi1cEM03k9Y?t=1816), [09-25](https://youtu.be/Bi1cEM03k9Y?t=1837), [08-16](https://youtu.be/gf_6GveiAls?t=901))
- Boston is projected to be a better regular season team than last season, with about 48 wins. (verdict, 2026-09-25; [07-30](https://youtu.be/TiiaNZCJNs8?t=2194), [09-25](https://youtu.be/Bi1cEM03k9Y?t=191), [07-02](https://youtu.be/P6TNP-g0wzY?t=272), [07-07](https://youtu.be/ME-r173X5b0?t=2186))
- He joined Boston in the Jaylen Brown trade. (fact, 2026-07-30; [07-30](https://youtu.be/TiiaNZCJNs8?t=305), [07-02](https://youtu.be/P6TNP-g0wzY?t=488))
- He probably will not stay in Boston long. This may be his only season there. (verdict, 2026-07-30; [07-30](https://youtu.be/TiiaNZCJNs8?t=2262))
- A rebound in his rim finishing toward 63% plus one or two more shots per game would make him a top 40 player. (verdict, 2026-07-16; [07-16](https://youtu.be/-y6p5PYLf00?t=1192))

**Durable**
- Steals are his best category, and he makes threes in volume. He is an excellent free throw shooter, but his field goal percentage is weak. (fact, 2026-10-16; [09-15](https://youtu.be/KPdD91Oo8-U?t=1125), [07-13](https://youtu.be/Rqb5GdrSweY?t=1393), [08-30](https://youtu.be/Alwse2uXzD4?t=1693), stats)
- His game is very fantasy friendly. He is worth more in category leagues than in points leagues. (verdict, 2026-10-08; [09-25](https://youtu.be/Bi1cEM03k9Y?t=1633), [10-08](https://youtu.be/6DnRWahYrFA?t=1964), [10-04](https://youtu.be/n4KkK-OJjqA?t=1836), [08-30](https://youtu.be/Alwse2uXzD4?t=1693))
- He has a long injury history. It includes knee problems over several years, plus UCL and shoulder problems. (fact, 2026-09-30; [09-25](https://youtu.be/Bi1cEM03k9Y?t=936), [07-13](https://youtu.be/Rqb5GdrSweY?t=1393), [09-10](https://youtu.be/dlo7L8Ru91A?t=1181), [07-02](https://youtu.be/P6TNP-g0wzY?t=460), [09-30](https://youtu.be/BjXP9JODDSg?t=1032))
- He served a 25-game PED suspension last season. (fact, 2026-09-25; [07-02](https://youtu.be/P6TNP-g0wzY?t=460), [09-17](https://youtu.be/ahNxsoU8Hx4?t=610), [09-25](https://youtu.be/Bi1cEM03k9Y?t=894), [08-19](https://youtu.be/J1Eg3uaAICU?t=1762))
- He is an adaptable star role player who can scale his usage up or down. He is not just a 3-and-D player. (verdict, 2026-07-16; [07-02](https://youtu.be/P6TNP-g0wzY?t=460), [07-16](https://youtu.be/-y6p5PYLf00?t=1192))

**Tags**
- Current: `new team` (Traded from Philadelphia to Boston in the Jaylen Brown trade), `role up` (Moves from third option to clear number two behind Tatum; usage projected 26, up from 23), `injury last season` (Knee surgery recovery and a 25-game PED suspension), `bounce-back` (More games and a rebound in rim finishing expected), `sleeper` (ADP around 75 to 80, experts see top 40 per game), `expert target` (Happily taken in the 60s; Josh would pay up to 20 USD), `back-to-back risk` (Expected to sit about 8 to 10 of Boston's 16 back-to-backs), `many back-to-backs` (Boston has 16, tied for the most in the league), `winning team` (Boston projected at about 48 wins), `sites disagree on price` (Yahoo value 14 USD, ESPN value 3 USD; ESPN projects far more points)
- Durable: `injury prone` (Knee problems for years, plus UCL and shoulder), `off-court risk` (25-game PED suspension last season), `category league player` (Worth more in 9-cat than in points leagues), `fits every build` (No weak category flagged; steals and threes are his strengths)

**Note.** Experts agree he is underpriced. Most see a top 40 per game player with top 30 upside as Boston's number two option, while Yahoo's average cost is 2.3 USD, ESPN's is 4.0 USD and he went for 9 USD in our league last season. Prices of 10 to 15 USD look like good value, and Josh would go up to 20 USD. Steals, threes and FT% are his strengths, and with no weak category he fits any build. Early in the season, check how many of Boston's 16 back-to-backs he sits, whether his usage really rises next to Tatum, and whether his FG% recovers from about 44%.
